nodes.label: Open Graph Share Card (Coracao Presente)
nodes.rationale: A single flat 1200x630 raster carries the entire store pitch because WhatsApp/Facebook/Twitter render the preview before any of the site's HTML, CSS or fonts load; nothing in the card can depend on the app being reachable.

nodes.label: Coracao Presente Brand Lockup
nodes.rationale: Full lockup (mark + 'coracao' serif wordmark + 'presente' gold script with flourishes) is given its own half of the canvas so the brand is recognizable at feed-thumbnail scale, where body copy is unreadable.

nodes.label: Heart-Enclosing-Gift Logo Mark
nodes.rationale: A single continuous red line traces a heart outline that resolves into a ribboned gift box, fusing 'affection' and 'present' into one glyph instead of stacking two separate icons.

nodes.label: Hero Claim: Cestas & Presentes, escolhidos a dedo
nodes.rationale: Category ('Cestas & Presentes', bold red serif) leads and the differentiator ('escolhidos a dedo' = hand-picked, gold italic) follows as a curation promise, positioning the store against generic marketplace gift listings.

nodes.label: Nationwide Delivery Promise (Entrega para todo o Brasil)
nodes.rationale: Answers the first objection a Brazilian shopper has to an unfamiliar gift shop shared by a friend - 'do they even ship to my state?' - before the click, not after.

nodes.label: Free Shipping Above R$ 299
nodes.rationale: Set in muted gray at the smallest size: a conditional incentive that raises average basket value but must not compete visually with the unconditional nationwide-delivery claim above it. Hard-coding R$ 299 into a raster means any change to the threshold requires re-exporting this asset.

nodes.label: Printed Domain coracaopresente.com.br
nodes.rationale: Burning the URL into the pixels keeps the store reachable when the card is screenshotted and re-forwarded through WhatsApp, where the surrounding link chrome and og:url are stripped away.

nodes.label: Two-Panel Split Layout (Identity | Claim Stack)
nodes.rationale: Logo isolated on the left half against a lighter blush wash, copy left-aligned on the right half in a descending weight stack. The vertical split tolerates the center-crop that chat clients apply to wide previews better than a centered logo-over-text composition would, and the gold hairline rule separates emotional pitch from logistical facts.

nodes.label: Crimson / Gold on Cream Palette
nodes.rationale: Deep crimson for affection and call-to-action, antique gold for premium gifting, warm cream/blush gradient ground instead of white so the card stays legible and non-clinical against both light and dark chat bubbles.

nodes.label: Serif-Brand / Sans-Utility Type Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: High-contrast serif and script carry brand and emotion (headline, tagline, wordmark); a neutral grotesque carries the scannable operational facts (shipping, threshold, domain). The register switch tells the reader which lines are persuasion and which are information.

nodes.label: 1200x630 Preview Canvas
nodes.rationale: The 1.91:1 size expected by Open Graph and Twitter summary_large_image; content is kept clear of the outer margins so center-cropping to squarer chat thumbnails does not clip the logo or the domain.

nodes.label: Social Share Preview Role (og:image / twitter:image)
nodes.rationale: This asset is the store's entire first impression on WhatsApp, Facebook and Twitter, rendered by the crawler with no JavaScript, no fonts and no live data - so every claim on it is a frozen copy of store policy that can drift from the running site.

nodes.label: Audience: Brazilian Gift Buyers Receiving a Shared Link
nodes.rationale: Portuguese-only copy, BRL pricing and a nationwide-Brazil shipping claim target a domestic consumer who arrives through a forwarded link rather than search, which is why the card argues trust and reach rather than showing product photography.

hyperedges.label: Pre-Click Value Proposition Stack
hyperedges.rationale: Read top to bottom the four right-panel lines form one argument - what we sell, that we can reach you, what it costs to reach you, and where to go - compressed into the only surface a recipient sees before deciding whether to tap a forwarded link.

hyperedges.label: Brand Identity System (Mark, Lockup, Palette, Type)
hyperedges.rationale: Mark, wordmark, crimson/gold palette and the serif-plus-script register are one reusable identity kit; the share card is one application of it, so the same tokens should recur in the storefront UI, and any drift between them shows up as an off-brand preview.

hyperedges.label: Crawler-Safe Static Composition
hyperedges.rationale: Fixed 1.91:1 raster, crop-tolerant split composition and fully flattened text exist together because social crawlers execute no scripts and load no webfonts; every constraint here follows from the preview being rendered outside the application.
